construction: Forty-eight complete painted figures: four retained approved contact/recovery drawings and forty-four ImageGen-authored leg-continuity repairs. No detached rigs, pose warps, pixel restoration or crossfaded anatomy.
registration: Fixed 0.70 whole-source density for new masters, calibrated against the approved body model; measured eyes/neck/belt locate each complete drawing. Retained raw keys keep their original 0.60 density and registration. No occupied-height or foot fitting.

frames.notes: Complete individually image-authored frontal figure. Fixed whole-source density; eyes register the source translation and independently measured neck/buckle check model continuity. No body-part transforms, face pastes, occupied-bound fitting or interpolated anatomy.
